title: Capstone: Network Operations Center (NOC)
description: Deploy a full NOC with LibreNMS, Nagios, Grafana dashboards, Prometheus, and automated alerting.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Build a fully operational Network Operations Center that monitors infrastructure health in real time. Deploy LibreNMS for automated network device discovery and SNMP-based monitoring, Nagios for host and service health checks with escalation policies, Prometheus for time-series metric collection, Grafana for visualization dashboards, and Alertmanager for routing alerts to a Slack webhook. Create custom dashboards showing network health at a glance, configure automated host discovery so new devices appear without manual intervention, and build escalation policies that page on-call engineers when critical services go down.

### Why This Matters
A NOC is the nerve center of any IT organization. Network engineers and sysadmins who can build and operate NOC infrastructure are essential to keeping businesses online. This capstone proves you can integrate multiple monitoring systems into a cohesive observability platform, configure alert routing with escalation, and build dashboards that give operators actionable visibility into infrastructure health.

### Environment
- Image: ubuntu:22.04
- Tools: librenms, nagios, prometheus, grafana, alertmanager, snmp
- Login: root / ItLab2025!

### Architecture
- LibreNMS on port 8080 with SNMP discovery
- Nagios on port 8081 with escalation policies
- Prometheus on port 9090 scraping targets
- Grafana on port 3000 with NOC dashboards
- Alertmanager on port 9093 routing to Slack

### Deliverables
1. LibreNMS discovering network devices
2. Nagios checking host availability
3. Prometheus collecting metrics
4. Grafana dashboards showing network health
5. Alertmanager routing alerts to Slack
6. Custom NOC dashboard
7. Escalation policy tested
8. Automated discovery working

### Permissions
- Container runs as root
- LibreNMS: admin / ItLab2025!
- Grafana: admin / ItLab2025!
tasks: Install and configure LibreNMS with SQLite backend
Enable SNMP discovery and poller modules
Add simulated network devices to LibreNMS
Install and configure Nagios Core with CGIs
Create Nagios host and service definitions
Install and configure Prometheus with SNMP exporter
Install and configure Grafana with Prometheus datasource
Import and customize NOC dashboard in Grafana
Create Alertmanager routing rules for Slack
Verify automated discovery finds new SNMP devices
